title: Life Master star: Ju Men
body_md:
With Ju Men as Life Master you have a questioning mouth and mind: articulate, analytical, quick to ask and hard to persuade. You suit work built on words, research, law, teaching. The classics call Ju Men the "dark star", meaning it shines into shadowed places and finds what others miss.

The blind spot is talk that turns into gossip, doubt that turns into suspicion, and wounding people with a sharp phrase without meaning to. Ju Men must learn well-timed silence. This week, in one conversation, try only asking and listening, offering no opinion at all.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10

title: Life Master star: Lian Zhen
body_md:
With Lian Zhen as Life Master you have a layered character: principled yet passionate, craving discipline yet pulled by strong feeling. You have magnetism, work wholeheartedly and despise pretence. The classics call Lian Zhen both the "prison star" and the "secondary peach blossom", meaning this energy can become order or become entanglement.

The blind spot is extremity, loving and disliking too sharply, and making life hard with exacting standards. Given a worthy aim, Lian Zhen is remarkably persistent. This week, pick one rule you impose on yourself and ask whether it still serves you.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Life Master star: Po Jun
body_md:
With Po Jun as Life Master you have the energy of someone who opens a road by clearing the old one: unwilling to settle, ready to leave a job, a place or a habit and begin again. You spend heavily but regenerate fast, create freely and are not afraid of chaos. The classics call Po Jun the "star of expenditure", governing depletion, upheaval and renewal.

The blind spot is tearing down without building, acting on impulse, and exhaustion from living in a permanent restart. Po Jun needs a direction to pour itself into. This week, before you drop anything, write down what you will build in the space it leaves.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Life Master star: Qi Sha
body_md:
With Qi Sha as Life Master you have the temperament of a vanguard general: fierce, bold, able to bear solitude and unafraid to change the whole direction of your life when needed. You hate half-measures, prize loyalty and do what you say. The classics call Qi Sha the "general star", governing authority and major turning points.

The blind spot is impatience, high-handedness and manoeuvring yourself into one-against-all. Qi Sha lives on goals; without one it grows restless. This week, pick one battle that truly matters and deliberately walk away from one small argument.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Life Master star: Tai Yang
body_md:
With Tai Yang, the Sun, as Life Master you have a sunlit temperament: generous, open, outgoing and drawn to work that benefits many people. You struggle to keep secrets, dislike injustice and willingly carry the shared load. The classics say Tai Yang governs reputation more than money, and lights up others more than itself.

The blind spot is giving until you are drained, flaring up at anything unfair, and tending the wider world while the people at home go unnoticed. This week, give one full evening to family or a close friend with no talk of work.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Life Master star: Tai Yin
body_md:
With Tai Yin, the Moon, as Life Master you have a lunar temperament: gentle, private, emotionally rich and aesthetically sensitive. You work quietly, like things clean and ordered, think of others first and trust your intuition. The classics link Tai Yin to property and to the mother, governing quiet accumulation.

The blind spot is oversensitivity, hiding feelings so well that those close to you cannot tell you are sad, and swinging with your moods. Tai Yin shines brightest when trusted and given room of its own. This week, tell one person close to you what is weighing on your heart before they have to guess.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Life Master star: Tan Lang
body_md:
With Tan Lang as Life Master you have abundant vitality and strong appetite: for learning, for play, for experience, with easy sociability and natural charm. You are multi-talented, adapt fast and are seldom bored. The classics call Tan Lang the "primary peach blossom", governing desire as much as the capacity for self-cultivation, depending on how it is used.

The blind spot is wanting many things at once, sliding into indulgence, and losing patience once the novelty wears off. Tan Lang paired with discipline becomes exceptional. This week, drop one time-eating pleasure and give those hours to a skill you left half-learned.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Life Master star: Tian Fu
body_md:
With Tian Fu as Life Master you have a composed, generous, conserving manner: you are like a full storehouse, fond of stability, good at husbanding resources and rarely caught short. People feel safe around you. The classics call Tian Fu the commanding star of the Southern Dipper, governing assets and protection.

The blind spot is conservatism, avoiding risk, and holding on so tightly that even what should be given away stays locked up. Tian Fu suits a supporting role more than a showy one. This week, give away one object or a small sum without anyone knowing.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Life Master star: Tian Ji
body_md:
With Tian Ji as Life Master you have a quick, restless mind: you like reasoning, planning, finding the cleverer route, and you make a fine strategist for others. You learn fast, improvise well and often see several moves ahead. The classics call Tian Ji a "benevolent star", governing intelligence and a leaning toward the good.

The blind spot is overthinking, changing your mind constantly and worrying so far ahead that sleep suffers. When your wit has no proper outlet, it drifts into petty scheming. This week, take one decision you are weighing and settle it within twenty-four hours, then do not reopen it.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Life Master star: Tian Liang
body_md:
With Tian Liang as Life Master you have the temperament of the family elder: calm, protective, fond of teaching and able to defuse trouble. You matured early and people come to you for counsel. The classics call Tian Liang the "sheltering star", governing the turning of misfortune into safety.

The blind spot is imposing "for your own good", stepping too far into other people's lives, and sighing over the state of the world. Tian Liang also tends to meet the trouble first and the rescue second. This week, let someone close handle their own problem; stand beside them without jumping in.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Life Master star: Tian Tong
body_md:
With Tian Tong as Life Master you have a mild, easygoing temperament with an endearing childlike streak: you enjoy comfort, savour small pleasures and rarely make enemies. You carry a natural good luck and find people willing to help you. The classics call Tian Tong the blessing star, governing ease and harmony.

The blind spot is avoiding hardship, compromising too readily, postponing unpleasant tasks and waiting for others to decide. Tian Tong needs a challenge to wake it up. This week, take on one task slightly beyond your comfort and finish it without asking for help.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Life Master star: Tian Xiang
body_md:
With Tian Xiang as Life Master you have the bearing of a trusted minister: upright, considerate, eager to help and skilled at bridging people. You value courtesy, dress with care, and are often trusted as the go-between or the indispensable second-in-command. The classics call Tian Xiang the "seal star", governing support and credibility.

The blind spot is living for other people's approval, helping until you vanish, and finding it hard to say no. Tian Xiang is strongly shaped by the stars beside it, so your environment matters a great deal. This week, decline one request that does not truly need you.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
author: human

title: Life Master star: Wu Qu
body_md:
With Wu Qu as Life Master you have the character of a general who also keeps the treasury: decisive, practical, hardworking and very capable with money, numbers and assets. You say little and do much, dislike dawdling and want results you can measure. The classics call Wu Qu a wealth star, governing gains earned through effort.

The blind spot is firmness hardening into coldness, putting tasks above people, and a loneliness that comes from rarely showing feeling. Wu Qu does well beside people who soften it. This week, say something warm to someone close without attaching advice or a comment.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10

title: Life Master star: Zi Wei
body_md:
The Life Master star marks the centre of gravity of your chart, the temperament you carry for life. When it is Zi Wei, the Emperor star, you have a natural bearing of leadership: you like to be respected, you organise well and you do not shy from large responsibility. People find it easy to trust you with important things.

The blind spot is pride, a taste for flattering words and discomfort when corrected in public. Zi Wei needs its "court", capable collaborators, or it grows lonely at the top. This week, thank one person publicly who has been quietly supporting you.
source_ref: Tử Vi Đẩu Số Toàn Thư (命主 tradition); editor seed 2026-10
